claims.statement: Allocation rule set v18 went live at 22:00 and orders became stuck at 06:00 on the east node only, establishing a temporal and operational correlation

EXC-0921 orders (v18 split-reservation orders) are booked at a timing that causes them to miss the carrier confirmation window: median confirmation arrival is 47 minutes post-booking, but pickup slots close after 30 minutes, whereas non-EXC-0921 orders booked before 05:58 receive confirmations within their slot windows
The root cause is that v18's allocation behavior changed the booking timing for split-reservation orders, placing them outside the carrier confirmation window
claims.limitation: The exact parameter/logic change in v18 that shifted booking timing requires code review; the root mechanism is established via discriminating evidence

claims.statement: The impact is 186 orders held in 'awaiting pickup' state, representing 9% of overnight allocations, blocking customer fulfillment
The applied mitigation (slot correction) failed because it was directed to the wrong feed before confirmation of the exact failure mechanism

next_action.rationale: Root cause is established with discriminating evidence: v18 changed allocation behavior such that split-reservation orders (EXC-0921, 100% of stuck orders) are booked at a timing that places them outside the carrier confirmation window (47-minute median latency vs. 30-minute slot closure). Non-rule-affected orders booked earlier were confirmed successfully. The attempted mitigation (slot correction) failed due to being applied to the wrong feed, requiring human operator involvement to correct. Assessment complete; recommended engineering follow-up is detailed review of v18's allocation logic changes and remediation (partial rollback, timing adjustment, or corrected re-booking with proper scoping).
